## 1. What happened and what were you expecting?

We are facing a little issue when executing the test payments_api_consents_rejection-reason_test-module_v3.

The step ExtractAuthorizationCodeFromAuthorizationResponse is expecting authorizationcode from response, but its confusing because we won't generate a authorizationcode when the consent will be rejected.

We would like to understand this scenario with you and know if this step could be change.
